name: crewstack
description: CREWSTACK — full-stack team task manager with role-based access (Admin/Member). Built on PostgreSQL + Prisma + React.

scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.build: npm install --prefix server && cd server && npx prisma generate && cd .. && npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.start: cd server && npx prisma db push --skip-generate --accept-data-loss && node src/index.js
